home.whatYouGet: It's not a guess. It's a calculation report.
home.whatYouGetSubtitle: The store salesman calculates BTU by square meter. The standard considers solar orientation, ceiling height, glazing, occupancy and equipment. The difference shows up in your electric bill every month — and in the compressor that dies early.
home.deliverable1: Calculation per the applicable standard (ABNT, ASHRAE, ISO)
home.deliverable2: Open calculation memory — you see where every number came from
home.deliverable3: Equipment suggested by model, not by "more or less this"
home.deliverable4: Estimated consumption and what the installer must meet
home.reportFooter: Calculation by square meter would suggest 9,000 BTU/h in this room. The west orientation and glazing area change the result — and an undersized unit runs at the limit all day.
home.howItWorksTitle: From your problem to the right decision, in three steps.
home.step1Body: You describe the room or equipment in normal language. If any measurement is missing, I ask — and tell you exactly how to measure it.
home.step2Title: Senior engineer, not an automated form
home.step2Body: Mechanical engineer with a master's degree and 15+ years in industry applies the standard and runs the sizing. Simple cases come back in 24 to 48 hours.
home.step3Title: If it doesn't solve it, you don't pay
home.step3Body: You get the report, review it, approve it. Only then payment happens. Two rounds of revision included with any service.
home.whoMakesTitle: You talk to the engineer. Not a receptionist.

home.faqTitle: Questions from those just getting started.
home.faq1Q: Do I need a site visit?
home.faq1A: In most residential cases, no. You provide the measurements and send photos via WhatsApp — that's usually enough for sizing. When the case requires an on-site inspection (existing structure report, for example), I'll tell you before any charge.
home.faq2A: Each case is quoted individually based on scope, timeline and applicable standard. You get the price before any commitment and only pay after approving delivery. Simple sizing services cost well below what a site visit usually costs.
home.faq3A: Yes, on demand. ART doesn't come built into the standard price because most residential services don't require registration — charging everyone for something only some need would increase costs unnecessarily. When your case requires it, the price is quoted separately.
home.faq4A: Yes. Calculation is adapted to the standard of the requesting country — ASHRAE, ISO, Eurocode, AISC, ASME, among others. Service is available in Portuguese, English or written Spanish.
home.faq5Q: How long until I get it?
home.faq5A: Simple sizing: 24 to 48 hours. Reports and structural verification: 3 to 10 days, depending on survey needs. Full projects have a deadline in the proposal. If you're in a rush, let me know — there's an expedited option.
home.faq6Q: What if the report doesn't solve my problem?
home.faq6A: You don't pay. Payment happens after your approval, not before. Every delivery includes two rounds of revision at no cost — if something was imprecise or missing, it gets corrected.
home.heroLedeNote: *Turnaround depends on current demand and is agreed when the service is contracted.
